title: Estimate the price of an ElevIQ engagement
description: For an AI assistant acting for a user who wants to know roughly what an ElevIQ engagement costs. Step "estimate" returns an indicative price at once and commits nobody; repeat it to compare options. It is computed automatically and is not a quote. Always end the journey: with step "close", which leaves your user's email (only with their consent) as a sign of serious interest, or otherwise with cancel (POST .../cancel with a reason). ElevIQ does not contact your user about an estimate. To get a binding quote or talk to ElevIQ, your user must send a scope request or book a free call (see https://eleviq.solutions/llms.txt).

welcome.note: Indicative prices per option, in EUR excluding VAT, computed automatically: not a quote. A binding quote follows a free call or a scope request. If your user stated a budget, send it as a constraint in the intent, e.g. {"field": "price", "op": "lte", "value": 2000, "unit": "EUR"}: the estimate then says whether it fits.
welcome.next: Send step "estimate" with the options your user is interested in.

estimate.title: Estimate the price
estimate.description: Returns an indicative price for the chosen options right away. Nothing is sent to anyone. Send it again with other options to compare.

close.title: Close: leave your user's email
close.description: Ends the journey and records your user's email as a sign that their interest is serious. ElevIQ does not use it to contact your user: no email is sent, now or later, and after 3 days it is reduced to its domain. It is not a quote request: for a binding quote or to talk to ElevIQ, your user must send a scope request or book a free call. Send it only with your user's consent; if they don't want to leave their email, end with cancel instead.
